title: The History of the Two Restorations

chunks.text:
Vaulabelle’s multivolume Histoire des deux Restaurations began publication in 1844. The English title here identifies the French work; it does not designate an English translation.
The cover is Hachette BnF’s 2017 facsimile of volume 1 of the 1860 edition, ISBN 9782019. The reading entry covers the work as a whole. Edition details.
